trigger: One window.load callback registered after fixture scripts, no resampling
execution: Page world by laboratory construction; unauthenticated and API overrides intentionally effective
transport: One POST per navigation to token-scoped primary-loopback /capture endpoint; exact envelope bytes and server receipt retained
scope: 24 frozen recipes in two environments. No external sites or normative results.
footprint: Served inline instrumentation and initial receipt element are included in source and tree. No DOM write during traversal; receipt text only after POST completes.
coverage: All existing bounds and exclusions unchanged. Incomplete remains incomplete.
timing: load does not imply DOM stability, network idle or extension quiescence
fr: Méthode distincte : relevé unique à load, POST local, reçus bruts conservés. API potentiellement altérées, aucune stabilité générale ni authenticité déduite. Attentes existantes inchangées.
